markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: there be 就是「**某个地方有某个东西**」：桌上有本书 = There's a book on the table。这里的 there **不是**「那里」，只是个开头。

uses.en: [[Is there]] a coffee shop near here?

positive.title: 肯定：is 还是 are
positive.rule: be 看**后面的东西**：一个、或者不能数的（milk、time），用 is；好几个，用 are。口诀：**一个用 is，好几个用 are。**

examples.en: [[There's]] a problem with the login page.
[[There are]] two new people on the team.

notes: 后面有好几样东西时，看**第一个**：There [[is]] a laptop and two phones on the desk.

wrong.bad: There ~~is~~ two bugs in this file.
wrong.good: There [[are]] two bugs in this file.

negative.title: 否定：没有
negative.rule: is、are 后面加 not；也可以更简单地说 **There's no + 东西**。

examples.en: There[['s no]] time to test it properly.

question.title: 疑问：有没有
question.rule: 把 is、are 挪到 there 前面。回答也用 there：Yes, there is. 不说 Yes, it is。

examples.en: [[Is there]] a lift in this building?
How many people [[are there]] on your team?

tenses.title: 过去和将来
tenses.rule: 说过去、将来，**只改 be**，there 不动。

items.en: There [[was]] a power cut last night.
There [[were]] lots of people at the meetup.
There[['s been]] an accident on the motorway.

this.en: [[There are]] eight people on our team.

commonMistakes.why: 「有」某件事，用 there is，不用 there have。

commonMistakes.bad: ~~In my office has~~ a coffee machine.
commonMistakes.good: [[There's]] a coffee machine in my office.
commonMistakes.why: 中文「我办公室有……」要换成 there is，地点放后面。

commonMistakes.bad: Is there a lift? — Yes, ~~it is~~.
commonMistakes.good: Is there a lift? — Yes, there [[is]].
commonMistakes.why: 用 there 问，就用 there 答。

accept: There is a meeting at ten.
There's a meeting at ten o'clock.
There is a meeting at ten o'clock.

traps.input: There have a meeting at ten.
traps.note: 「有」某件事用 there is，不用 there have。

quiz.prompt: There ___ two new people on the team.
There ___ some milk in the fridge.
There ___ a laptop and two phones on the desk.

traps.note: 看紧跟的第一个东西 a laptop，用 is。

quiz.prompt: 改成否定句：There is some coffee left.
accept: There is not any coffee left.

quiz.prompt: Sorry, there ___ time to test it properly.
quiz.explain: There[['s no]] + 东西 = 没有。

quiz.prompt: 改成一般疑问句：There are some questions.
quiz.explain: Are 挪到 there 前面，some 变 any：[[Are there]] any…？

quiz.prompt: — Is there a lift in this building? — Yes, ___ is.

traps.note: 用 there 问，就用 there 答。

quiz.explain: 用 there 问，就用 [[there]] 答。

quiz.prompt: 按括号里的提示提问：There are eight people on our team.（问「几个人」）
quiz.answer: How many people are there on your team?
accept: How many people are there in your team?
How many people are on your team?
How many people are in your team?

quiz.prompt: There ___ (be) a power cut last night.
There ___ (be) lots of people at the meetup yesterday.
There ___ a short delay to the 8:15 train.
改错：In my office has a coffee machine.
quiz.answer: There's a coffee machine in my office.
accept: There is a coffee machine in my office.
In my office, there's a coffee machine.
In my office there is a coffee machine.
My office has a coffee machine.

quiz.prompt: 改错：There have a meeting today.
改错：There is three bugs left.

openTask.prompt: 用 there be 介绍你的办公室或家附近：写 4 句，至少一句用复数，一句否定，一句问「有没有」。
rules: 一个或不可数用 is，好几个用 are，看后面紧跟的第一个东西
不说 there have；疑问把 is / are 放到 there 前面
openTask.note: 规则判 is / are 的选择和语序（计分）；离线模型给更自然的说法（AI 建议，不计分）
